# fhvite

## Usage

### Installation

Install the latest version from pypi:

``` bash
pip install fhvite
```

## How to use

Import into an existing FastHTML application and add the following:

``` python
from fasthtml.common import *

# Add this import
from fhvite.core import add_vite

app = FastHTML()

# Add this line
add_vite(app)
```

At app startup,
[`add_vite`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/fhvite/core.html#add_vite)
creates missing setup files, runs `pybun install`, builds assets with
`pybun run build` and adds the entry-point scripts and stylesheets to
the app header. Installation follows the project’s lockfile.

For a prebuilt deployment, use `add_vite(app, run_build=False)`. It
reads the existing manifest without creating setup files, installing
dependencies or building. Both modes serve content-hashed build assets
through FastHTML’s `StaticImmutable`.
